description: Create a new KaiCalls agent — the secretary that answers this business’s calls (the live voice agent plus KaiCalls records) — with a system prompt, greeting, voice, and model. Mirrors POST /api/v1/agents. Every subsequent mutation to this agent is versioned (assistant_config_versions) and reversible via rollback_config — history is listed by get_change_history / list_config_versions. Compliance: KaiCalls automatically applies state-aware AI-disclosure and consent handling to every agent it provisions, and flags high-risk business categories for extra review.

business_id.description: Business ID to create the agent under.

first_message.description: Spoken greeting (optional). Leave it out to use the industry intake greeting, which opens on the caller's need.

model.description: Language model selection: { provider, model, temperature } (optional).

system_prompt.description: The agent's inbound system prompt (optional). Leave it out to start on the business's industry intake script, the same one a signup gets.

vertical_pack.description: Setup pack id, e.g. 'personal-injury' (optional; inferred from the business when left out).

voice_catalog_id.description: Preferred: a curated catalog id from list_voices (optional).

name: create_agent
title: Create Agent
